chunks: From him, from Hammad, from Shu'ayb, from Abi Basir, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a pregnant woman who sees blood. He said: “Yes, indeed a woman may sometimes discharge blood while she is pregnant.”

key_terms.الدَّمَ: blood seen or discharged by the woman

ai.seo_question: Can a pregnant woman see blood according to hadith from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the legal issue of a pregnant woman seeing blood. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام affirms that a pregnant woman may sometimes discharge blood, which is relevant in discussions of menstruation and related rulings.
